title: Technical Audit of ChatGPT / GPT-5.6 Sol Reliability: Instruction-to-Action Binding and Multimodal Workflow Incidents
description: Public technical audit and evidence package documenting repeated reliability failures in a long-running ChatGPT / GPT-5.6 Sol multimodal workflow. The report distinguishes instruction comprehension from execution, focuses on state-to-action and correction-to-action binding, preserves source-provenance and causal-evidence boundaries, and includes a controlled repeated-run series plus supplemental observations from 4–6 September 2026. The current public text is privacy-redacted: medical diagnosis, medical cause, functional impairment, treatment history and other health information concerning the real portrait subject are intentionally excluded, and a stable identity-relevant visual characteristic is referred to neutrally as FEATURE-F1 where necessary. Internal OpenAI causes are not asserted without telemetry. Full v1.3 report text is available in English and Russian; the 4–6 September supplement is currently English-only.
